blockers.wanted: a swell knob (claim attack up) that moves the amplitude rise time
blockers.tried: ramp (smooth) times a falling curve, into a bp-filtered white noise; the knob moved the envelope but verify's attack stayed ~150 ms at every position, because a constant-Q bandpass on white noise gets louder as its centre rises, so the sample peak sat at the filter's peak time
blockers.workaround: an expr node that divides the level by sqrt(f) (a * g * sqrt(1500 / f)); found by listening to the intermediate node amp with a sweep

blockers.wanted: replace a node by another type under the same name (math -> expr, or math -> curve)
blockers.workaround: delete op and a new name, then re-point readers; twice cost a failed call

blockers.wanted: no modes / inharmonicity lines for a pure noise sweep
blockers.workaround: ignored the modes list (2-4 kHz 'modes' at -30 dB) and the 360-430 cents inharmonicity

wishlist: a ready 'whoosh' / swept-noise node with swell time, peak centre frequency and level compensation
an attack-claim reading of the smoothed RMS (as swell/attack headline) rather than the sample peak, which a noise sweep pins to its filter peak
retyping a node under its own name in one sound_ops call
what_worked: curve node as a lookup of one ramp gave both the filter sweep and the envelope shape in a few lines
swell/attack headline plus centroid by tenth read the brief's targets directly (109 ms; 1.2k -> 4.5k -> 2.0k Hz)
verify's macro sweeps showed immediately that the swell knob did not move the attack
